settings.label: Turns per game
settings.help: How many turns (days) a game lasts before it ends and scores. The classic game plays 30.

settings.label: Starting cash
settings.help: Cash a new player starts with, before the starting loan.

settings.label: Starting debt
settings.help: The loan shark debt a new player starts owing.

settings.label: Debt interest rate (%)
settings.help: Percentage the loan shark debt grows each turn it goes unpaid.

settings.label: Bank interest rate (%)
settings.help: Percentage cash left in the bank earns each turn.

settings.label: Announce events to LiveChat
settings.help: Busts, attacks, deals and high scores go out through the board's announcer (LiveChat and any webhook the sysop subscribed) instead of staying silent.
